'''Riallin''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.

==Appearance==
She has vivid yellow-red hair and is a little plump. She always has a ready grin.

==Activities==
She stands guard when [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron]] and then [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] both enter the Throne Room of [[Cairhien]]. She distrusts Cadsuane and veils when Cadsuane is meeting with [[Rand al'Thor]].

She greets Rand in [[Bandar Eban]] and points him towards where [[Milisair Chadmar]] is being held.
